  "memo":"R03 holds: the Vietnam-issued card was used from a Canadian IP and CVV failed. Card is the sole adverse family; no other rule condition holds. No household exception is needed, and no earlier outcome settles the order. A legitimate customer using their established foreign-issued card with a CVV entry error remains plausible, but familiarity does not establish current authorization. Under FP-2 §6.6(b), recommend needs_check with the required id_check; contact is not required. No checks have run and the order is unshipped. The analyst can implement this as a verification hold. A passed id_check requires clear; failure requires decline absent Linkage."
